message.scp_unleashed.scp999.refuses: There is nothing in there to take hold of. Just a lot of very happy jelly.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp999.0: Walkers keep reporting a little orange jelly that bounces up and hugs them.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp999.1: Nobody has been hurt. Everyone who meets it comes back smiling.
SCP-999, "The Tickle Monster": a small, cheerful blob of orange jelly with two curious black eyes. Safe-class.
It loves people, sweets and company, and it is very fond of a gentle pat.
Spending time near it does wonders for cuts and bruises. It does not like trouble one bit.
It never spawns naturally. Its file comes from the Archive.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chocolate_orbs.1: Little candy-shelled chocolates in every colour. A quick, light snack.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.chocolate_orbs.2: Something small, orange and squishy finds them impossible to resist.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.pink_dog_bowl.1: A cheerful pink pet bowl, made at the Decoration Workbench. It holds a few servings of Chocolate Orbs.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.pink_dog_bowl.2: A pet that knows where its bowl is will help itself when it fancies a treat.

dossier.scp_unleashed.999.title: The Tickle Monster
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.caption: SCP-999 during its morning visit to the staff canteen. It would not hold still for the photograph.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.0.text.0: SCP-999 is kept in a padded, brightly lit enclosure in the Light Containment wing. During the day the enclosure door is left open and SCP-999 may wander the wing, provided a member of staff is nearby.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.0.text.1: SCP-999 is returned to its enclosure each evening. It settles more readily if someone says goodnight to it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.0.text.2: Its food bowl is kept stocked with candy and nothing else. Staff on break are encouraged to visit and play with it. **Visitors are asked to speak to it calmly and to keep weapons and open flames well away from it.** %rFurther procedures withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.1.text.0: SCP-999 is a soft, translucent mass of orange jelly roughly eighty centimetres across, with two small black eyes. It has the consistency of warm peanut butter and a faint, pleasant smell that every observer describes differently.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.1.text.1: It moves in short hops and can reshape itself at will, from a tall droplet to a wide puddle. It greets people by bouncing up to them, wrapping them in a hug and tickling them until they laugh.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.1.text.2: Contact with SCP-999 brings on a mild, lasting sense of wellbeing, and staff who spend time near it report that cuts and bruises heal noticeably faster.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.1.text.3: SCP-999 is drawn to anyone who is hurt or unhappy and will stay close until they feel better. It is easily startled by aggression, fire and loud noises, and presses itself flat against the floor until it feels safe again.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.1.text.4: It eats only sweets, and is especially fond of small candy-coated chocolates.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.2.title: Addendum 999-1: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.2.text.0: SCP-999 was found on the edge of %rHollow Pine%r State Park after several walkers reported being "ambushed by a jelly that just wanted a cuddle". Recovery agents located it within the hour.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.2.text.1: It followed them back to the van of its own accord, chirping the whole way, and fell asleep on the back seat before they reached the Site.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.3.title: Addendum 999-2: Test Log Excerpts
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.3.text.0: **Test 999-04:** SCP-999 was introduced to a room of D-Class personnel who had just been told their transfer request was denied. Within ten minutes every subject was laughing. Two asked whether they could stay.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.3.text.1: **Test 999-07:** A hostile specimen was released into the adjoining cell. SCP-999 flattened itself against the floor and trembled until the specimen was removed, then hopped to each member of staff in turn to make sure they were all right.
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.4.title: Addendum 999-3: Memo
dossier.scp_unleashed.999.page.4.text: From Dr. %rOkafor%r: "Please stop topping up its bowl with your own sweets. It is supposed to be on a diet. It is also extremely good at looking hungry."
